Today we remember an 18y/o #RamarleyGraham, who was killed by #NYPD plainclothes officers in front of his grandmother & 6y/o brother. We say his name & stand with his family.

NYC must end failed policing practices that led to Ramarley's killing. #BlackLivesMatter #SayThierNames https://t.co/cADHNioiX6

A NYS judge dismissed Officer Wayne Isaacs’ baseless attempt to block his long-delayed discipline trial for killing #DelrawnSmall

Delrawn's fam: It’s unacceptable that the City & NYPD allow Isaacs to collect a paycheck & patrol NYC streets. Schedule the trial! #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/gtRME9rGsx

Thank you @readersdigest for listing CPR as one of the 50 #BlackLivesMatter charities and organizations to donate to right now! 

We are honored to have earned your support and to be in good company. ✊🏿

https://t.co/dieOCkiC3I

Today is #DelrawnSmall's birthday, he should be alive! Please help celebrate his life by uplifting his family's demand for the #NYPD & @NYCMayor to immediately schedule the disciplinary trial & #FireWayneIsaacs for brutally killing Delrawn in 2016. Like & Share. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/UzoRzgRwMd
